segments.title: Locked ChatGPT chats have a catch
segments.say: ChatGPT can lock your chats now. But there's a catch.

segments.title: How it works
segments.say: Locked chats sit behind a four digit PIN, or Face ID, and leave your history and search.

segments.title: Forget the PIN = chats deleted
segments.say: But if you forget the PIN, resetting it permanently deletes every locked chat.

segments.title: Hidden ≠ encrypted
segments.say: And locking isn't encryption. It hides chats. It doesn't change how they're stored.
Use a PIN you'll remember. Follow for honest AI tips.
